title: rosa multiflora f. cathayensis
intro: Rosa multiflora f. cathayensis, commonly known as the Chinese rose, is a fragrant and ornamental flowering plant native to China and Korea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for various health benefits. It is said to help reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of fever, while also exhibiting antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Rosa multiflora f. cathayensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as reducing fever and inflammation.
